product_info.title: Foldable Adjustable Phone Holder Stand
product_info.description:
Foldable Adjustable Phone Stand for Desk, Office & Home
Upgrade your workspace or home setup with this foldable adjustable phone stand, designed for all your daily needs whether in the office, kitchen, or living room. Keep your phone organized and easily accessible while working, video chatting, cooking, or streaming your favorite content on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok.

Ergonomic & Multi-Angle Design
Enjoy ultimate comfort with 90° height and 45° angle adjustment, allowing you to find the perfect viewing position and reduce neck or back strain. Built for long-term use, this stand supports over 20,000 continuous adjustments without loosening.

Durable, Stable & Anti-Slip Base
Crafted with a 120g weighted pedestal and a sturdy aluminum alloy support rod, this desktop phone holder ensures excellent stability and can hold devices up to 1kg without tipping. The anti-skid silicone pads keep your phone safe from scratches and slips.

Portable & Travel-Friendly
Compact and lightweight, this foldable mobile stand easily fits into your bag perfect for travel, business trips, or daily use. Its minimalist design makes it a great gift ideafor friends, family, or colleagues.

Universal Compatibility
Compatible with all smartphones and tablets, whether large or small, ensuring a secure and stable hold for any device.
